data.summary: App shell is composed from Sidebar, AppMainContent, ChatSidebar, and AppRightPanels through useAppViewModel/useAppStartup.
Desktop startup syncs configured API base into Tauri and requests Rust host to start backend only under Tauri runtime.

data.insight: React UI delegates gateway process management to Rust host, which resolves base URL, health checks, and API proxying.
Current local evidence says release decision is GO on 2026-04-07, with all blocking checks passing.

data.name: mixed hard-and-soft gates
data.description: The main integration workflow keeps several warning-only jobs while also enforcing selected hard-fail contracts.

data.insight: Node/TypeScript is the authoritative runtime path, while Python is retained as explicit compatibility fallback and web root is deprecated by default.

data.point: Core delivery path is healthy, but the repo still has transition-era complexity that should be reduced now that the Node-first path is working.
